models.name: ARGUS-PRISM WarmthScore
models.one_liner: Six weighted behavioural signals -- velocity, round-trip, structuring, dormant-device, profile mismatch, SIM swap.
models.method_note: Their six signal functions and their published weights, reimplemented from ARGUS-PRISM/backend/app/engines/warmthscore/signals.py and evaluated as of the complaint time instead of the wall clock. Their SIM-swap signal needs a telco feed this dataset does not have, so 10 of their 100 points are unavailable in every case.

operating_point.calibration_note: All four systems may flag at most 12 accounts on this case. A bank's investigation desk has a fixed daily capacity, so this is the comparison that matches how the alerts would actually be worked.

equal_alert_budget.calibration_note: All four systems may flag at most 12 accounts on this case. A bank's investigation desk has a fixed daily capacity, so this is the comparison that matches how the alerts would actually be worked.

equal_fpr.calibration_note: Thresholds chosen per system so all four flag the same 12% of the innocent accounts in this case.

native.calibration_note: Each system at its own published threshold. The operating points differ, so the counts are not directly comparable -- which is the point of the other two modes.

models.one_liner: Graph-topology features -- PageRank, reciprocity, ring membership, community and second-hop fraud rate.
models.method_note: Their feature set, computed exactly as their feature_engineering.py computes it.
